camel_example: aliyun sas AddSasModuleTrial --region cn-hangzhou --ModuleCode vulFix --Lang zh
description_en: Enables the trial use of Security Center value-added features, including vulnerability fixing and threat analysis and response
description_zh: 增加云安全中心增值模块的试用，包括漏洞修复、威胁分析与响应等模块
kebab_example: aliyun sas add-sas-module-trial --module-code vulFix --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddSasModuleTrial

parameters.help_en:
The code of the feature. Valid values:

vulFix: vulnerability fixing.
cloudSiem: threat analysis and response
parameters.help_zh:
模块code。取值：
vulFix：漏洞修复
cloudSiem：威胁分析与响应
parameters.name: module_code

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh：中文

parameters.name: lang

TrialRecordList.description_en: The information about the trial use

AuthLimitList.description_en: The list of quotas. This parameter is available if the value of the ModuleCode parameter is cloudSiem. The value of this parameter consists of the log storage capacity for the threat analysis and response feature and the log data to add. Units: GB and GB-day
AuthLimitList.description_zh: 授权额度列表。当ModuleCode为cloudSiem时有效，含义分别为威胁分析与响应日志存储容量（GB）和日志接入流量（GB/天）

GmtEnd.description_en: The end time of the trial use

GmtStart.description_en: The start time of the trial use

ModuleCode.description_en:
The code of the feature. Valid values:

vulFix: vulnerability fixing.
cloudSiem: threat analysis and response
ModuleCode.description_zh:
模块code。取值：
vulFix：漏洞修复
cloudSiem：威胁分析与响应

Status.description_en:
The status of the trial use. Valid values:

1: The feature is in trial use.
0: The trial use ends
Status.description_zh:
试用状态。取值：
1：试用中
0：试用结束
